profile.headline: Software Engineer III  at Wayfair
profile.summary:
High performing full-stack web developer well-practiced in working in cross-functional teams and a multiplier for growth of my mentees. Passionate about feature performance, stability and improving team processes through Agile philosophy and automation.

Tech I use: Java Spring Boot, Typescript, React, GraphQL, PostgresQL, MSSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Lead medium to large technical projects collaborating with product, design, and analytics, serving as a strong voice for engineering and performing effective project planning in JIRA
- Launched the Customer Acquisition experience for the Wayfair Professional x Capital One financing product currently producing a $30MM annual run rate
- Cultivate learning culture by hosting bi-weekly engineering sessions discuss best practices, demo new tools and frameworks, and share knowledge
- Promote sustainable team culture through by implementing Agile processes such as average velocity-based sprint planning, refinement priority ranking, reducing redundant meetings

Frontend: Typescript, Javascript, React
Backend: Java, Spring Boot, PHP, Kubernetes, Docker, Istio, Cloudspanner, MSSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed and developed tools for business customers such as Quotes, Invoices, and Tearsheets
• Owned the full refactor of the onsite Order Invoice experience to use new underlying microservice data providers, resulting in significant improvements in latency measured at the P50-P95 level and stability through closure of all existing bug tickets
• Tech designed the Favorites project management view initiative, breaking down 3 months of sprint work into tickets and guiding fellow developers on requirements and tech design
• Shared best practices in performance and code quality by giving team tech talks on React performance optimization, Test Driven Development, Point-free programming, and Datadog 
• Mentored junior engineers through code review, 1 on 1s, and recommendation for new opportunities
• Regularly improved team processes through new ideas in retro, saved time and increased visibility of sprint progress by automating tasks/notifications in JIRA and Slack

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Launched Arlow, an web/iOS app for interior designers to do end to end project management
• Owned the order tracking feature, using the UPS/USPS/FedEx APIs to retrieve updated shipping and delivery information for products
• Identified a major bottleneck with product fetching and implemented best practice GraphQL deferred resolvers to do batch loading, significantly improving server response times for a major feature
• Developed performant full-stack web app features using ReactJS, Apollo GraphQL, PHP and SQL
• Collaborated heavily with product, design, and QA to build and maintain features

positions.title: Online STEM Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students in multiple subjects, including C, C++, Java, Javascript, algebra, probability, and statistics. Consistently earned 100% 5-star performance rating and recognized as one of the top 10 tutors in C Programming.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Refactored software architecture to implement MVC pattern. Removed size of main.c file by 80%, significantly decreasing cognitive load and improving code reuse.
• Developed new features for the Greinon system control software GUI to improve data visualization and user experience in C++ and Qt.

Greinon is a start-up aiming to revolutionize the smart city with its wireless modules that plug into infrastructure like streetlights collecting environment data and optimizing power usage.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Successfully created a MVP over-the-air firmware update system in C using BLE
• Designed and implemented the state machine business logic for scanning, pairing, and updating device firmware

positions.title: Software V&V Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Performed high-volume black box stress testing developmental software builds on disease assays
• Proficient in verification and validation testing in an FDA / UL regulated environment
• RCA with multiple groups of local and remote SW & HW engineers to triage bugs
• Experience writing SQL queries in MSSQL and HP ALM / Quality bug tracking software
• Experience with Class II device testing and medical device life cycle process, IEC 62304

positions.title: Software Testing Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
I worked in the Android Bluetooth software testing department, where I was responsible for testing multiple Android Bluetooth profiles such as OPP, A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, and PBAP on new Android N developer builds. My initial responsibility was to execute these integration tests, and triage and fix the tests by referencing Bluetooth SIG spec and PTS. 

Due to my programming background, I was shifted to another project to write a sanity testing suite for minimum BT feature compliance. I used Perl and Android uiautomatorviewer to complete over 60 test cases for the suite, complete with a daily autorun script, Excel report compilation, and email notification. 

Accomplishments:
• Developed an automated sanity test suite in Perl to verify Android Bluetooth compliance, meeting 117% of target test case count
• Wrote multiple Batch scripts to automate test device initialization, test execution, report compilation, and email notification

honors.title: UCEAP Promise Scholarship (Spring 2017)

projects.title: SpeechView
projects.description:
•	Designed a wearable that uses an iOS app to convert speech to text and display it on glasses
•	Responsible for iOS app development for speech to text and transmitting data to wearable

projects.title: Burundi Library Project
projects.description:
Responsible for designing and implementing a community library constructed out of a shipping container in Bujumbura, Burundi.
- Designed the 1 kW solar power system and 600 Ah battery backup array
- Integrated a Hall-effect sensor-based current monitoring device into the solar power system
- Researched optimal airflow and lighting conditions inside the library

organizations.name: Tzu Chi Collegiate Association
organizations.position: Senior Advisor, Vice President · Mar 2013 - Present
organizations.description:
The Tzu Chi Collegiate Association is a volunteer organization that works to provide college students with opportunities to learn and grow from service. The organization's motto is "Act with wisdom and compassion; learn from and inspire each other."

Everybody Reads: Bi-weekly tutoring/mentoring event located at the Oceanside Community Center where we work together with local elementary, middle, and high school students on school subject material, while also providing a safe space to nurture their sense of kindness and compassion to those around them. (Oceanside, CA)

Convalescent Home Visit: Monthly performance/care oriented event located at Carmel Mountain Rehabiliation Center where we invite collegiate and high school age volunteers to spend a morning with seniors in a local convalescent home. We sing, dance, perform, and interact with the seniors to bring smiles and laughter to their days. (Carmel Valley, CA)

Happy Campus: A weekly event mentoring/tutoring event located at the Herbert Ibarra Elementary School where we provide mentoring and tutoring services to a specially designated class of students grades K - 5. We also work with the local food bank to provide a food package for each student to bring home over the weekend. (San Diego, CA)
